using System;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;
using Microsoft.Extensions.VectorData;
using Microsoft.SemanticKernel.Data;
using Microsoft.SemanticKernel.Embeddings;
using Xunit;

namespace Microsoft.SemanticKernel.Test;

public class TextSearchServiceCollectionExtensionsTests
{
    [Fact]
    public void AddVectorStoreTextSearch_ObsoleteOverloadWithTextEmbeddingGenerationServiceId_CallsGetServiceForStringMapper()
    {
        // Arrange
        var services = new ServiceCollection();
        services.AddSingleton<ITextSearchStringMapper>(new MockStringMapper());
        services.AddSingleton<VectorStoreTextSearchOptions>(new VectorStoreTextSearchOptions());
        services.AddSingleton<IVectorSearchable<TestRecord>>(new MockVectorSearchable<TestRecord>());
        services.AddKeyedSingleton("embedding", Mock.Of<ITextEmbeddingGenerationService>());

        // Act
        services.AddVectorStoreTextSearch<TestRecord>(
            vectorSearchServiceId: "vector",
            textEmbeddingGenerationServiceId: "embedding",
            stringMapper: null);

        var serviceProvider = services.BuildServiceProvider();
        var factory = serviceProvider.GetKeyedService<Func<IServiceProvider, object, object>>("default") 
            ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("Factory not registered");

        // Act - trigger the factory lambda to execute the GetService call
        var _ = factory(serviceProvider, null!);

        // Assert - no exception means GetService was called successfully
        Assert.True(true);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void AddVectorStoreTextSearch_ObsoleteOverloadWithTextEmbeddingGenerationServiceId_CallsGetServiceForResultMapper()
    {
        // Arrange
        var services = new ServiceCollection();
        services.AddSingleton<ITextSearchResultMapper>(new MockResultMapper());
        services.AddSingleton<VectorStoreTextSearchOptions>(new VectorStoreTextSearchOptions());
        services.AddSingleton<IVectorSearchable<TestRecord>>(new MockVectorSearchable<TestRecord>());
        services.AddKeyedSingleton("embedding", Mock.Of<ITextEmbeddingGenerationService>());

        // Act
        services.AddVectorStoreTextSearch<TestRecord>(
            vectorSearchServiceId: "vector",
            textEmbeddingGenerationServiceId: "embedding",
            resultMapper: null);

        var serviceProvider = services.BuildServiceProvider();
        var factory = serviceProvider.GetKeyedService<Func<IServiceProvider, object, object>>("default") 
            ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("Factory not registered");

        // Act - trigger the factory lambda to execute the GetService call
        var _ = factory(serviceProvider, null!);

        // Assert - no exception means GetService was called successfully
        Assert.True(true);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void AddVectorStoreTextSearch_ObsoleteOverloadWithTextEmbeddingGenerationServiceId_CallsGetServiceForOptions()
    {
        // Arrange
        var services = new ServiceCollection();
        services.AddSingleton<ITextSearchStringMapper>(new MockStringMapper());
        services.AddSingleton<VectorStoreTextSearchOptions>(new VectorStoreTextSearchOptions());
        services.AddSingleton<IVectorSearchable<TestRecord>>(new MockVectorSearchable<TestRecord>());
        services.AddKeyedSingleton("embedding", Mock.Of<ITextEmbeddingGenerationService>());

        // Act
        services.AddVectorStoreTextSearch<TestRecord>(
            vectorSearchServiceId: "vector",
            textEmbeddingGenerationServiceId: "embedding",
            options: null);

        var serviceProvider = services.BuildServiceProvider();
        var factory = serviceProvider.GetKeyedService<Func<IServiceProvider, object, object>>("default") 
            ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("Factory not registered");

        // Act - trigger the factory lambda to execute the GetService call
        var _ = factory(serviceProvider, null!);

        // Assert - no exception means GetService was called successfully
        Assert.True(true);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void AddVectorStoreTextSearch_ObsoleteOverloadWithTextEmbeddingGenerationServiceId_ThrowsWhenStringMapperNotRegistered()
    {
        // Arrange
        var services = new ServiceCollection();
        services.AddSingleton<VectorStoreTextSearchOptions>(new VectorStoreTextSearchOptions());
        services.AddSingleton<IVectorSearchable<TestRecord>>(new MockVectorSearchable<TestRecord>());
        services.AddKeyedSingleton("embedding", Mock.Of<ITextEmbeddingGenerationService>());

        // Act & Assert
        services.AddVectorStoreTextSearch<TestRecord>(
            vectorSearchServiceId: "vector",
            textEmbeddingGenerationServiceId: "embedding",
            stringMapper: null);

        var serviceProvider = services.BuildServiceProvider();
        var factory = serviceProvider.GetKeyedService<Func<IServiceProvider, object, object>>("default")!;
        
        var exception = Assert.Throws<InvalidOperationException>(() => factory(serviceProvider, null!));
        Assert.Contains("ITextSearchStringMapper", exception.Message);
    }

    private class TestRecord { }

    private class MockStringMapper : ITextSearchStringMapper
    {
        public string MapToSearchableText(TestRecord record) => string.Empty;
    }

    private class MockResultMapper : ITextSearchResultMapper
    {
        public TextSearchResult MapToTextSearchResult(TestRecord record) => new(string.Empty, 0);
    }

    private class MockVectorSearchable<TRecord> : IVectorSearchable<TRecord>
    {
        public IVectorStoreRecordCollection<TRecord> Records => throw new NotImplementedException();
        public IEmbeddingGenerator<string, Embedding<float>>? EmbeddingGenerator => null;
        public VectorizedSearchOptions? DefaultSearchOptions => null;

        public Task<IReadOnlyList<TRecord>> VectorizedSearchAsync(
            ReadOnlyMemory<float> queryVector,
            VectorizedSearchOptions? options = null,
            CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
            => throw new NotImplementedException();
    }
}
